I change only the comparison. Here is the diff in `spe/evals/harness/grader.js`:

```js
// before
const priorityMatch = out.priority === ref.priority;
// after
const normPriority = (p) => String(p ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
const VALID = new Set(["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]);
const priorityMatch =
  VALID.has(normPriority(out.priority)) &&
  normPriority(out.priority) === normPriority(ref.priority);
```

I check every other string comparison in the grader for the same bug. Category is the main one to check, for example "Billing" against "billing". I apply the same normalization wherever I find it.

I add these selftest cases:

```js
{ out: "p1",   ref: "P1", expect: true  },
{ out: " P2 ", ref: "P2", expect: true  },
{ out: "P2",   ref: "P1", expect: false },
{ out: "high", ref: "P1", expect: false },
{ out: "",     ref: "P1", expect: false },
{ out: "P5",   ref: "P1", expect: false },
```

I run the selftest. The oracle must pass, and empty and wrong outputs must fail. If the selftest does not pass, I halt and report.
